content: UUIDv5 = SHA-1(namespace_bytes + name_bytes) with 6 bits of the hash overwritten to set version=5 and variant bits, per RFC 4122/9562. Node has no built-in v5 generator; crypto.randomUUID() is v4-only. A hand-rolled implementation using node:crypto's createHash('sha1') is straightforward (~20 lines) but reimplements a standardized algorithm with easy-to-get-wrong bit-twiddling; the 'uuid' npm package's v5() implementation is the de facto standard and is dependency-free itself.
